name: Nelivaptan
summary: Nelivaptan is a selective, orally active, non-peptide vasopressin V1B receptor antagonist. The drug had entered clinical trials for treatment of anxiety and depression. In July 2008, Sanofi-Aventis announced that further development of this drug had been halted.

pharmacology.text: Nelivaptan (INN; developmental code names SSR-149415, NB-415, and BH-200) is a selective, orally active, non-peptide vasopressin V1B receptor antagonist.

uses.text: The drug had entered clinical trials for treatment of anxiety and depression.

fact.en: It blocks the V1B receptor for vasopressin, a hormone better known for controlling how much water the kidneys keep, but which also acts in the brain's stress circuits.
fact.zh: 它阻斷血管加壓素的 V1B 受體。這種荷爾蒙較為人知的功能是調節腎臟保留多少水分，但它在大腦的壓力迴路中也有作用。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断血管加压素的 V1B 受体。这种荷尔蒙较为人知的功能是调节肾脏保留多少水分，但它在大脑的压力回路中也有作用。
